INPUT 1 is the approved ORIGINAL Incline Dumbbell Bench Press and the immutable, sole visual style control. No new blue palette, fog, neon, shirtless posing, branding, text, numbers, watermarks, anatomy highlights or gym clutter. One athlete only, natural proportions, neutral focused expression, two anatomically plausible hands with wrapped grips, physically coherent implements and support/contact shadows. Fit the WHOLE athlete, both complete shoes, all weights/bar ends and bench/support feet within the square with about 8% breathing room; action occupies roughly 80–85% of longest image axis, not a tiny figure. Canonical MovementDefinition 128. INCLINE BENCH REAR DELT FLY. Prone torso lengthwise on a shallow 25-degree incline bench, upper chest supported, feet planted behind. No rowing elbow flexion, no upright standing lateral raise. Show low incline, whole figure and bench feet, neutral head looking diagonally down.
